en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with historic buildings. Dominating the scene is an ornate city hall with a tall clock tower and baroque details, fronted by a stepped stone terrace. Surrounding it are multi‑story façades with shop signs and a church in the background. The caption at the bottom reads in Hungarian: "Pécs. Széchenyi tér és városháza." The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, a blue Hungarian stamp, and a circular postmark from Pécs.
